subject: Luminary Health — Ambassador Activation Lattice (post-sign)
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ames <jordan.ames@luminaryhealth.com>, Priya Narang <priya@luminaryhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Luminary Health — Ambassador Activation Lattice (post-sign)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Congrats again on getting the SOW across the finish line. Quick handoff note so CS/SE can take ownership of the activation:

Deal highlights (short):
- Commitment: 30 ambassador seats, production start target: 2026-11-15 (billing starts 2026-11-01)
- Pilot scope: ambassador routing, webhook integrations to their CRM, and embedding for clinician workflows
- SLO: 99.9% inference availability for core endpoints; stdev latency target <= 120ms p50

Technical & access notes:
- We have a dedicated cluster reservation on us-west-2. Account ID and org-level IAM invite sent separately.
- Test data: Priya will provide a masked CSV with sample payloads (expected by 10/25).
- Network: L4 outbound allowed to *.redwood.ai and provisioning of the 3 IPs in the attached network_requirements.xlsx

Success criteria for go-live (to be validated in kickoff):
- End-to-end happy path for three templated prompts + webhooks firing to CRM
- Throughput profile validated at 5 requests/sec sustained for 30m on staging
- Acceptance signoff in ticketing system from Luminary PM

Recommended owners (provisional):
- Primary CSM: Monica Patel (onboarding, adoption plan, success criteria)
- Solutions Eng: Aditya Rao (integration, network, staging validation)

Action items I’m handing off now:
1) Monica to schedule a 60-min kickoff with Luminary and internal SEs (preferably week of 10/26)
2) Aditya to provision staging endpoints and share test credentials + the network checklist
3) Priya to send masked test data and confirm SSO timeline

Attachments: Luminary_SOW_signed_v3.pdf, network_requirements.xlsx, activation_checklist.csv

Thanks team — Jordan/Priya please let us know if anything above is inaccurate. We’ll plan for an internal pre-kickoff sync (15m) day before the external kickoff.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Jordan Ames <jordan.ames@luminaryhealth.com>, Priya Narang <priya@luminaryhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Luminary Health — Ambassador Activation Lattice (post-sign)

Thanks Steph — looping in details and proposed plan.

Appreciate the clear summary. I'll take Primary CSM ownership. Quick clarifying Qs before I put the kickoff on the calendar:
1) Pilot acceptance — who on Luminary will sign the acceptance ticket? Jordan, can you confirm the approver (name + email)?
2) Do we have any data residency constraints beyond us-west-2? I want to flag any EU/PA compliance items early.
3) Priya — sample payload schema: can you confirm whether PHI is present in the sample or if it will be fully de-identified? We can take masked CSV but need to know fields so SE can map ingestion.

Proposed internal routing & immediate next steps:
- Internal pre-kickoff (15m): Monica + Aditya + Stephanie — propose Thu 10/22 at 10:00am PT
- External kickoff (60m): target Tue 10/27 at 09:00am PT (Luminary + Monica + Aditya + 1 infra PM)
- Milestone cadence: weekly check-ins (30m) + acceptance gate on 11/12

I will create the activation runbook from the attached activation_checklist.csv and send a draft by EOD Friday (10/23). Aditya, please confirm staging creds + IP whitelist ETA so I can include in the runbook.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Quick update from the SE side — I’ll handle the staging provisioning and network checklist.

Status ETA:
- Staging endpoints provisioned: 10/23 EOD PT
- Staging credentials + test API key shared via secure link: 10/24 morning
- IPs for whitelist: included in attached network_requirements.xlsx (3 addresses)

Notes / caveats:

- I attached a short playbook snippet (internal link) that documents our typical ambassador routing test cases and the smoke test checklist.

Proposed owners (confirmed):
- CSM (primary): Monica Patel
- SE (primary): Aditya Rao

I’ll join the internal pre-kickoff Thu 10/22 10:00am PT and external kickoff Tue 10/27 09:00am PT.
